Stage2: heavy-8-batch all 200 on `/`, cf-ray present, honeypots 403 (path-selective Cloudflare/origin), no sucuri/malcare/sgcaptcha/wordfence body markers in any batch. hasWaf=false (operationally non-blocking from this IP). Stored DB profile contradicts (hasWaf=true, wafWorkaround=sucuri-cookie-cache) — likely stale residue from earlier audit when IP was challenged.

Stage3: platform=bigcommerce-stencil (cdn11.bigcommerce.com refs + stencil/* CSS paths). Klevu site-search overlay loaded via js.klevu.com/theme/default/v2/category-page.js (no server-side product cards). adapterType=generic-retail (BC Stencil routes through generic-retail.ts).

Stage4: HTML category pages return 0 products (Klevu client-side hydration). The runtime crawler reads siteProfile.apiConfig.klevuApiKey and calls Klevu wildcard SEARCH at https://uscs33v2.ksearchnet.com/cs/v2/search (per generic-retail.ts:362-446). Klevu wildcard returns 5264 products total — matches sitemap product <loc> count exactly. catalogUrls preserved as HTML start points for the fallback path; runtime walks Klevu wildcard for 100% coverage in one API stream.
Stage5: paginationPattern.type=api-offset. Klevu accepts limit (max verified 100) + offset. Tested offset=0 vs offset=50 disjoint IDs, pagination honored.

Stage6: Klevu accepts sort=RELEVANCE and PRICE_ASC (HTTP 200). NEWEST, DATE_DESC, NAME_ASCENDING return HTTP 500 'Invalid request'. No newest-first sort possible via Klevu API. BC HTML sort UI moot. HTML category pages have no products to sort. sortParam=null, sortVerified=false.
Stage7: A/B/C cascade. A skipped (no date filter on Klevu). B skipped (no newest-first sort). C selected: full-catalog-sweep with reason citing Klevu sort enum limits.
